_readme: S421 SkyTupelo, 2026-10-19. Five of Cañada's transfer-degree records (Mathematics 30741, Geography 32295, Child and Adolescent Development 35834, Social Work and Human Services 37122, Communication Studies 2.0 43478) name the degree total of 60 and the Cal-GETC pattern and print no units for it, so the degree check reads them incomplete; the Jev sitting of run 39197675380 named stated_total_counts_more for all five (kb/jev_harvest_verdicts/ca_ada.json). Taft's reconcile step (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json) sets Cal-GETC to the statewide 34 where the page words it 'Completion of ... Cal-GETC is required', and a step for Cañada needs Cañada's own words. This read prints the pages of the hand-filed catalog that name Cal-GETC, the sentence each transfer-degree page uses for it and for reaching 60, and where the catalog states Cal-GETC's units, if it does. One load of the hand-filed copy (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/ca_ada.json; robots.txt refuses the college's /current/), no model call. Second read: the first printed the catalog's front matter (pages 33-88; its general education page states 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) - 34 units minimum' and 'Canada local general education pattern - 25 units minimum', and the AA-T/AS-T requirements page says 'Certified completion of the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)'), and the 14-page cap never reached the program pages. The keywords now name the five programs' section headings and the degree-requirements line their records quote, so the pages printed are theirs.

questions.ge_units: How a Cañada transfer-degree page words Cal-GETC and the 60 units, and whether the catalog states Cal-GETC's units anywhere.
